tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: Lists the currencies a free invoice can be issued in. Pass the code, for example USD, as currency_code to generate_free_invoice.

tools.name: generate_free_invoice
tools.description: Creates a free invoice as a PDF without an InvoiceQuick account and returns a preview link and a PDF link that work for 60 days. It does not email anyone. Ask the user for the sender and recipient details; do not invent names or email addresses.
